Hi, I’m Anant. I build curious machines.

I make AI systems that crawl the web, read medical data, and listen for trouble inside a moving car.

I’m a final-year ECE student in Bengaluru, happiest where a model meets the messy parts of the real world: odd payloads, slow APIs, blocked pages, and tight latency budgets.

Lately, that has meant an autonomous newspaper and a vehicle intrusion detector running in under 15 milliseconds.

Bengaluru, India · graduating August 2027

some of my work

A newspaper with 8 minds ↗

Red Letter gathers stories across 22 publishers, clusters related reporting, and sends each event to the right AI persona.

Teaching a car to notice trouble ↗

Crucible watches 11 streams of CAN telemetry and spots suspicious behaviour in under 15 milliseconds.

Helping urgent cases move first ↗

Curieon turns incoming clinical data into a severity-ranked triage queue, even when the payloads arrive a little untidy.

Growing synthetic tumours in latent space ↗

A 2-stage diffusion pipeline trained on 24,000+ brain MRI slices from BraTS 2020.
